comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
🚨 **BLOCKING: `sm_tc_differential_triggered` is never removed — the dispatcher can never run twice for the same bug**

The SM rule stamps `sm_tc_differential_triggered` (`addLabel`, sm.json:94) and skips while it is present (`skipIfLabel`, sm.json:93) — but nothing in this PR ever removes it:

- `js/tcDifferentialDispatcher.js::action` removes only the park label (`removeLabelQuietly(tracker, ticketKey, parkLabel)` at lines 375 and 399); `grep -rn "sm_tc_differential_triggered"` finds no removal anywhere.
- The repo doctrine is that the job manages its own trigger label's full lifecycle: `js/quotaParkProbe.js` `liftPark()` (lines 117–123) removes the park label **and** the trigger labels on completion, and `js/smAgent.js:1289–1293` documents the pattern ("the job manages the label's full lifecycle — add is implied by dispatch, remove happens on its own completion").

Consequences — all three break the PR's own stated design:

1. **The documented retry loop never runs.** For an unavailable request the dispatcher posts one explanation and stays parked; your test states the intent explicitly: *"still parked — the label stays so the next tick retries"* (test_tcDifferentialDispatcher.js, stall suite). But the next tick is **skipped** by `skipIfLabel`, so the quiet-bump path (`occurrences > 1` in `dispatchRequests`) is unreachable in production and `occurrences` never advances past 2 (the test manufactures it by re-appending).
2. **A consumed bug is dead for all future rounds.** After a bounce/maintenance resolves the request and clears `tc_differential_pending`, any later park on the same bug re-adds `tc_differential_pending` — but the rule skips on the stale lock, while the generator rule now also skips `tc_differential_pending` bugs (sm.json:200). Result: no dispatcher, no generator, permanent attribution stall for that bug.
3. **A crash mid-dispatch locks forever** — the opposite of crash recovery.

Fix (follow the `quotaParkProbe.liftPark` precedent): in `action`, after the routes are posted and nothing remains parked, remove `sm_tc_differential_triggered` alongside the park label (keep the SM-side add as the in-flight crash guard). Add a unit test that a second `parkedFinding` round-trip dispatches again.

comments.body:
💡 **SUGGESTION: generated doc lists 11 customParams the dispatcher never reads**

`tc_differential_dispatcher.json` ships `"customParams": {}`, and `js/tcDifferentialDispatcher.js` reads exactly four: `tcRunCommand`, `workingDir`, `maxReworkRounds`, `parkLabel`. The generated doc's Parameters and "Custom params" sections (this file, lines ~48–64 and ~76–90) list 15, including `adoTextFormat`, `branchCreateFnPath`, `branchNamingFnPath`, `prSearchFnPath`, `scmProvider`, `stageFallback`, `targetRepository`, `trackerProvider`, `featureBranchEnabled`, `configPath`, `customStatuses` — none of which the dispatcher consumes.

A deployer configuring this job from the doc will hunt for knobs that do not exist (and may set `parkLabel` without realizing the SM rule's JQL must be overridden in lockstep — that caveat the human doc does carry, the generated one doesn't). The human doc (`docs/agents/tc_differential_dispatcher.md`) has the correct four — worth checking why `agentDocGenerator.js` over-collects for JSRunner configs so the next generated agent doc doesn't inherit the noise.

comments.body:
## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: Solid, well-tested feature (738+50 unit tests green locally), but 3 blocking issues must be fixed first: the `crap` CI ratchet is red on this head (14 new over-threshold functions), the `sm_tc_differential_triggered` lock label is never removed so the dispatcher can never run twice for the same bug, and a fail-closed (empty `machineAuthor`) ledger read makes the dispatcher silently strip `tc_differential_pending` from genuinely parked bugs.

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 `crap` gate red — "CRAP may only decrease", 14 new functions over threshold 8 (`js/tcDifferentialDispatcher.js::action` 12, `tcRoleStamp.stampPlan` 12, test fixtures up to 13)
- 🚨 Dispatcher lock label `sm_tc_differential_triggered` never removed (`js/tcDifferentialDispatcher.js` removes only the park label) — breaks the documented stall-retry loop and kills all future dispatches for the bug; `quotaParkProbe.liftPark` is the established fix pattern
- 🚨 Empty machineAuthor allowlist → `loadBugBookkeeping` fails closed → dispatcher clears the park label and un-blocks the generator on unparsed parked requests (violates the PR's own fail-safe contract)
- ⚠️ `testPath`/`lastGreenSha` from ledger markers interpolated into shell commands (`git checkout <sha>`, `tcRunCommand` substitution) without validation
- 💡 Unused `bugKey` param in `tcRoleStamp.roleFieldsFromDescription`; generated doc lists 11 customParams the dispatcher never reads; `summaryOf`/`ticketFields` duplication; per-tick dispatch cap is silent in the ticket report

**Next Steps**:
1. Fix the 3 blockers (refactor over-threshold functions; remove the trigger label on dispatcher completion; guard/bail the dispatcher when the allowlist resolves empty) — the lock-label and allowlist fixes both need new unit tests
2. Add sha/testPath validation routing to the existing `unavailable` fail-safe
3. Optional polish per the inline threads
